title: Hold Menu
description: A shelf of Beatles records with an iOS-style long press. Hold a cover and it sinks, then lifts free on a spring with its own colour glowing behind it while the page blurs away; a menu unfolds with Play Next, Add to Queue, Share and Go to Album. Keep holding, slide onto an action and let go to choose it.
intent: The context-menu moment from a music app finished to the edge: press, lift, blur, unfold, slide and release, with a spring that can be retargeted the moment you change your mind.
